exposure: non-b-lactam surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis (SAP) (including ciprofloxacin, vancomycin, and clindamycin)
cohort: Adult patients who underwent a major surgical procedure with surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis administration in 175 Swiss hospitals between January 2009 and December 2020.
finding: Administration of non-b-lactam surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis was significantly associated with a 1.8-fold higher odds of surgical site infection compared to b-lactam SAP (aOR, 1.78; 95% CI, 1.59-1.99).
